global_premortem.failure_mode: the one-chapter fallback or verse-by-verse atomization replaces the four coherent movements
global_premortem.recovery: Restore the four strategy macro parents and the exact LOW nested routes.

global_premortem.failure_mode: a Greek connector, variant marker, genitive, participle or translation rendering becomes automatic boundary authority
global_premortem.recovery: Null the selection, apply the case-by-case textual policy, and retain all exact alternatives.

global_premortem.failure_mode: the map decides lady/sister, opponent, authorship, date, source, Christology, hospitality/discipline policy, canon, doctrine or theology
global_premortem.recovery: Reject the inference and retain candidate-only, deferred, non-authorizing status.

global_guards: Greek words are considered only in phrase, clause, syntax and discourse context; no isolated lemma, root, Strong's tag or gloss is authority.
SBLGNT punctuation and variant sigla and WEB paragraphs, punctuation, headings, footnotes and Strong's-style tags are evidence only.
Textual variants trigger TCP-T378-B case-by-case process; this proposal selects no witness, reading, source tradition, translation or punctuation.
No authorship, date, addressee, opponent, source, reading, Christology, hospitality/discipline/church policy, canon, doctrine or theology selection.
All seams and routes are LOW, deferred, candidate-only and non-authorizing; no forced consensus and no official map write.
